title: morus nigra var. laciniata
intro: Morus nigra var. laciniata, commonly known as Cut-leaf Black Mulberry, is a variety of the black mulberry tree (Morus nigra) native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Morus nigra var. laciniata include its use as an antidiabetic and anti-hypertensive agent, as well as its ability to stimulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
